subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw add a default same-language response policy and automatic Korean-aware search behavior in core now that the Korean Control UI locale is shipped?
rationale: Current main already solves the UI locale portion, but the remaining request changes core agent prompt/search behavior and could affect mixed-language sessions and provider-specific search semantics.

options.title: Split and design agent policy
options.body: Keep this issue open for a focused maintainer decision requiring current Korean transcript proof, a provider-neutral prompt rule, and explicit search-parameter behavior before implementation.

options.title: UI-only scope
options.body: Declare the shipped Control UI locale sufficient for now and close or narrow the remaining agent-language request as out of scope.

options.title: Implement directly in core
options.body: Proceed with core prompt/search changes now, accepting the risk that the default policy may affect non-Korean or mixed-language conversations.

recommendation.title: Split and design agent policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a focused maintainer decision requiring current Korean transcript proof, a provider-neutral prompt rule, and explicit search-parameter behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest history on the shipped UI i18n path and closed the mixed-scope companion PR, making him the best routing candidate for deciding the split.
